description: This file implements a diff and patch library, including functions for computing differences between texts, generating patches, applying patches, and related utilities. It appears to be a version of Neil Fraser's diff_match_patch library, version 1.3.

classes.name: patch_obj
classes.description: Class representing a patch, including methods to convert to string, extract text1 and text2, and manage patch data.

methods.name: diff_main
methods.description: Computes the differences between two texts and returns an array of diff tuples.

methods.name: patch_make
methods.description: Creates a list of patches to convert one text into another, optionally using a provided diff.

methods.name: patch_apply
methods.description: Applies a list of patches to a text, returning the patched text and a list of success flags.
